I am ten years old and my baba gave me this plot to farm so I can learn. Last year he bought fertilizer when the government people brought the subsidized bags to our agro-dealer, and his millet grew taller than the unfertilized fields, so I will take a small share for my own land — I will put about 20 kilos of nitrogen on each hectare, which means a few bowlfuls on my 0.4 hectare plot. I will plant the local millet seed we kept from last harvest because we have no money for improved seed, and I will weed with my hands together with my mother and sisters. We do not have irrigation here, only the rains from June to September, and I will not hire any workers because I have no cash to pay them.
